lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-intensity circular local maxima arranged in roughly five distinct columns posterior to the gills. Blobs show higher luminance contrast in the medial region compared to the ventral-lateral area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features extend horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10 to 12 high-luminance blobs are distributed across the lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher spatial frequency observed toward the leading edge and base of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, thin white feature is visible trailing from the posterior edge of the pectoral fin, consistent with a parasite (remora) or external attachment; no permanent dermal scars or amputations are clearly visible.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more dispersed blobs on the primary lateral flank.
